**Provision of Public Goods/Services** - Provision of Drinking Water, Education, Justice and Law and Order, Medical and Health Facilities, Electricity to all, All weather roads.

**Provision of Infrastructure and Stimulus** - Policy Review and Reforms, Special Funds, Skill Development, Support to Infrastructural Projects, Governance.
